_nota: Datos SINTÉTICOS para probar el flujo completo sin esperar los abstracts reales. Tres temas: visión (V), lenguaje (L) y audio (A).

abstracts.texto: We propose a generative diffusion model for image synthesis that refines each pixel and improves visual quality.
A generative model of images based on diffusion: we sample pixel details and evaluate the visual realism of the images.
We propose a generative language model, a transformer that predicts the next token and follows a text prompt.
A transformer model for text generation: we study the prompt, the token distribution and the quality of language outputs.
We propose a generative model of speech that synthesizes a waveform and reproduces the voice and the sound of a speaker.
A generative audio model: we generate the waveform of the sound, the speech and the voice from short recordings.
